summary: Frontend-only QA of CR-557 (shared PopoutItemRow in ScanOrderPopOut) against the live preprod backend, logged in as Owner@thegoankitchen.com. LOGIN: PASS. It lands on /dashboard with 0 console errors and no 4xx/5xx responses. LIVE DATA LIMITATION: the account has only 3 running orders (1578953 t2 web f_order_status=1, 1578942 t1 web f_order_status=1, 1578881 room RM/pos) plus 1 Zomato delivery. None has f_order_status=7 and none has a food_status=7 line, so the ScanOrderPopOut never opens naturally. Mode A and Mode B cannot be reached with live data. To still check how the rows render, I ran Playwright response interception (client-side only, nothing written to the backend). I edited the browser's copy of employee-orders-list: (A) t1 set to f_order_status=7 with a food_status=3 line, a ₹1 line, a multi-group variation, an add-on and a note; (B) t2 kept confirmed, with some lines set to food_status=7 plus variations, add-on and note. Accept, Confirm-cancel and KOT print were never clicked, because they would act on real orders. RESULTS (simulated data): Mode A V1-V4 PASS. Mode B V5-V8 PASS. V9 PASS in both modes. V10 PASS in both modes. V11 PASS. BUG-679, BUG-702 and CR-545 in Mode B: PASS (simulated). CR-558: controls are present; no selective accept checkbox exists. The end-to-end flow is NOT TESTABLE (DATA). One issue already present before CR-557: the 'Check In' marker item leaks into the popout.

per_test_case_results.LOGIN_SMOKE: PASS - landing URL /dashboard. Console errors: 0. Only Firebase 'notification permission DENIED' warnings and the 'New version available' toast.

per_test_case_results.CR-557_ModeA_V2_cancelled: PASS (simulated) - food_status=3 row is line-through, labelled '(Cancelled)', price hidden, no KOT checkbox, no X.
per_test_case_results.CR-557_ModeA_V3_variations: PASS (simulated) - one line per option with its price: poil(+₹10), Hot(+₹15), Extra Cheese(+₹20).
per_test_case_results.CR-557_ModeA_V4_addons_note_comp: PASS for add-on (+ TEST_Dip +₹25) and note. Comp tag NOT TESTABLE: no complimentary item in the data.

A cancelled NEW row cannot happen by design: newItems drops status 'cancelled', and a cancelled line has food_status 3, so it shows under the previous items with strikethrough.

per_test_case_results.BUG-702_ModeB: PASS (simulated) - new and previous rows show their variation options with prices (prev row: poil(+₹10), Mild(+₹7)).
per_test_case_results.CR-545_ModeB: PASS (simulated) - ₹1 new item shows APS + Price TBD.
per_test_case_results.CR-558_OptionB: PARTIAL - Accept and per-item X are present and work up to the cancel modal; there is no selective accept checkbox (the only accept test-id is popout-accept-btn-{id}). End-to-end cancel → Accept → confirmed is NOT TESTABLE (DATA): no real web-edit order, and running it on intercepted data would change real orders.

ui_bugs.issue: Already present before CR-557, not a regression. The backend 'Check In' system item (isCheckInMarker, price zeroed in orderTransform.js ~L299-306) is not filtered. It shows as '1× check in ₹0.00' with a KOT checkbox and a cancel X, adds to the KOT (n) count, and is included in the item count. OrderEntry and RePrintButton already filter on isCheckInMarker.

issues: Row 1 uses justify-between across three children (name, price, cancel X). The price therefore sits in the middle of the row instead of right-aligned next to the X. Read-only rows (no X) right-align the price, so the price columns do not line up.
Line total shows unit×qty only and leaves out variation and add-on prices (₹100.00 shown while the options add +₹45 and the add-on +₹25). This may be intended, but it can confuse staff.

critical_code_review_comments: Filter isCheckInMarker in ScanOrderPopOut: the Mode A list, newItems, prevItems, formatItemCount and the KOT selectable set.
Mode A sort (L632-635) treats any unitPrice===1 as APS, including Comp items, while PopoutItemRow leaves Comp out of APS. Minor inconsistency.
ScanOrderPopOut.jsx is 769 lines (over 700); the selectable filter is copied 4 times in L595-627. Extract it into a helper.
Already noted in the handover, not CR-557: ScanOrderPopOut.test.jsx uses orderFrom:'web' instead of isWebOrder:true, causing 22 failures that were already there before CR-557.
action_items: Filter isCheckInMarker items out of ScanOrderPopOut lists, the item count and the KOT selection.
Right-align the price in PopoutItemRow, e.g. put price and X in one right-hand group or add ml-auto.
Create a real YTC Scan&Order web order and a real web-EDIT on preprod to re-verify V1-V8 and CR-558 end-to-end on real data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of reachable cases pass on simulated data; Mode A/B and CR-558 end-to-end NOT TESTABLE on live data
